faqs.q: Are your immigration advice fees fixed?
faqs.a: Yes. We agree a fixed fee in writing before we start, based on your application. If anything changes, we tell you before doing extra work.

faqs.q: Do your immigration advice fees include government fees?
faqs.a: No. Home Office, embassy and visa centre fees are paid separately, at cost. We tell you the total before you commit.

faqs.q: When do I pay your immigration advice fees?
faqs.a: Usually before we start work on your application. We confirm the payment arrangements when we agree your fee.

sections.heading: How our fees work
sections.text:
Our fee covers our advice and the preparation of your application. It is agreed in writing before we start, so there are no surprises. The fee depends on the type of application and how complex your circumstances are.

Government fees, such as Home Office application fees, the Immigration Health Surcharge and embassy or visa centre fees, are paid separately, at cost. We tell you the total before you commit.

sections.heading: What affects immigration advice fees?
sections.text: The fee depends on the type of application and how much work your case needs. A straightforward visitor visa needs less time than a spouse visa with self-employed income, or a sponsor licence for a new business. Previous refusals, gaps in documents or tight deadlines can add work. We tell you which applies at your consultation, so you know the cost before deciding.

sections.heading: Travel visa prices
sections.text: For travel visas and eVisas, our fees, the official fees and delivery charges are shown on each country's page.
